## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of the problem. Ex. "I'm frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Example usage:**

```typescript
// How you'd like to use this feature
```

## Use Case

Describe the use case and why this feature would be valuable:

- Who would benefit from this feature?
- What problem does it solve?
- How would it improve the library?

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

## DID Method Support (if applicable)

- [ ] This feature applies to did:web
- [ ] This feature applies to did:ethr
- [ ] This feature applies to a new DID method
- [ ] This feature is DID method agnostic

## Willingness to Contribute

- [ ] I'd be willing to implement this feature
- [ ] I'd be willing to help test this feature
- [ ] I'm just proposing the idea
